build_college_prompt: build a prompt for college students from a text snippet using the college style template
build_grade_school_prompt: build a prompt for grade-school students from a text snippet using the grade_school style template
run_build_science_prompts: run the script to build science prompts from AutoMathText dataset and push to HuggingFace Hub
run_all_styles: run the script with --run_all_styles to build prompts for both college and grade_school styles
refactor_build_prompt: refactor the build_prompt function to support a new educational style template
